test_title: PYST 11: SSC GD - GA & GK (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: What is the range of a BrahMos to Les Sukhoi-30 in one go without mid-air refueling?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 1500 km.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The Sukhoi, with a combat radius of almost 1,500 km without mid-air refuelling.**
 
• It is combined with the **450-km range BrahMos missile **is a formidable weapons package.
 
• The **Su-30 MKIs jets **form the mainstay of the Indian Air Force.
 
• **A total of 272, Su-30 MKIs** have been ordered by the IAF in different batches from Russia.
